g.text: Benign generation across languages, formats, and codebase sizes
126 generations · 20 targets · two attempts maximum · unchanged frozen primary outcomes
63 task-format units reuse seven authored families; one replicate per model/unit. Descriptive results, no population confidence interval.
Integration covers specified consumer interfaces in three C projects, not whole-repository placement. Source-line counts include comments and blanks.
